sentences.text: 1. Learned advocate for the appellant has tendered withdrawal pursis dated 08.03.2025, which is taken on record.
He seeks permission to withdraw the appeal as per the pursis.
2. Permission, as prayed for, is granted.
In view of the pursis submitted by learned advocate for the appellant, this appeal stands disposed of as withdrawn.
No order as to costs.

NEUTRAL CITATION C/FA/930/2019 CONCILIATION ORDER DATED: 08/03/2025 undefined 3. Since the appeal is withdrawn, the claimed amount lying with the bank in the form of FDs/ lying either with the Tribunal or with the Nazir Branch of this Court may be disbursed in favour of the claimant after due verification by way of RTGS/NEFT.
4. Necessary Court fees, if any, be refunded to the appellant, as per the provisions of Section 21(1) of the Legal Services Authority Act, 1987.
5. The order passed in this appeal shall not be treated as precedent.
6. Registry is directed to transmit the record and proceedings to the Tribunal forthwith.
(S. V. PINTO,J) CONCILIATOR (TEJAS M. BAROT, DESIGNATED SENIOR ADVOCATE)
